Dota 2.

You'll spend the rest of your sane life on it, you'll care about it more than you care about your own well being and hygiene, and you will throw all of your money at hats that don't do anything.

On a more serious tone, I would recommend it on it's merits of being one of the most exciting games there are out there - very few games can get me hyped in the same way that Dota can. It arguably has the highest skill ceiling of it's genre, and the diversity in playable characters is unlike any other. Every hero has a specific niche that makes for an infinite variety of strategies, every game is different from the last.

While it does suffer from having a pretty steep learning curve and a bit of an aggressive community, the matchmaking system is fairly good at putting you with players of your skill level and there's always the mute option.

The other big advantage is that they have recently ported custom games in the style of the olden Warcraft III days - so there are now a huge variety of tower defense and fun little game modes that are all playable for free.
